about: Krish's taste graph. All 346 tracks of his Spotify playlist 'Chillout & Ambient' (read 2026-11-13 from the Spotify Web API, with the date each was added). Release dates and added dates are from the Spotify Web API; labels from Spotify's album pages (the phonographic copyright line). Tempo, key, frequency balance, dynamics and arrangement are measured by trackcard on the full track for 342 tracks; each track's measured_from says which. Style families are inferred (Claude's read).

nodes.name: German and Euro melodic deep house
nodes.description: Warm, patient, melodic 4/4 at 118-124 BPM: long builds, emotive leads, deep subs. Berlin and the Stil vor Talent / Suol orbit.

nodes.name: Sunny deep house with a song in it
nodes.description: The 2013-15 crossover sound: a folk or pop vocal, sax, marimba or plucked hook over a soft deep-house groove. Bright, major, warm.

nodes.name: UK and soulful vocal house
nodes.description: Garage swing, diva or soul vocals, organs and chunky basslines; disco and nu-disco edges.

nodes.name: Downtempo, trip-hop and global fusion
nodes.description: Under or around 100 BPM, or swung: breakbeats, live instruments, world and Latin elements, electro-swing, cinematic chill.

nodes.name: Melodic progressive (Anjunadeep / Lane 8)
nodes.description: Anjunadeep and This Never Happened melodic progressive at 120-124 BPM: arpeggiated synth lines, rolling basslines, wide cinematic pads and long breakdowns into emotive peaks; bittersweet, mostly minor.

nodes.name: Organic, Afro and sunrise house
nodes.description: The All Day I Dream and TH3RD BRAIN orbit at 115-122 BPM: hand drums and shakers, kalimba, oud, flute and chanted or African vocals over soft, airy pads; dreamy, warm, often major.

nodes.name: Future bass and Aussie indie electronic
nodes.description: The 2014-17 Future Classic and Foreign Family sound: wonky or half-time beats around 75-110 BPM, side-chained supersaw chords, chopped and pitched vocal hooks and glossy indie-pop toplines; euphoric and nostalgic.

nodes.name: Groove-led tech house
nodes.description: The 2024-26 club turn at 124-130 BPM: rolling, swung basslines, crisp percussion, sparse stabs and chopped vocal hooks; driving and playful, with little harmony or melody.
